name: Fanwood-Scotch Plains YMCA Summer Camp
description_short: YMCA summer camps at the Fanwood-Scotch Plains Y: preschool camps for ages 2.5 to 5, full day camps for children entering kindergarten through grade 5, trip based excursion camps for grades 4 to 9, plus enrichment programs and a counselor in training program.

fees.name: Summer Camp/Enrichment Membership
fees.note: Per child, non-refundable, ends August 28; not needed if the child already has a youth, teen or family Y membership.

fees.name: Before care (7 to 9 am)
fees.note: Discovery, Explorer, Trailblazer, Adventure and Crossroads camps; none in week 9.

fees.name: After care (4 to 6 pm)
fees.note: Same camps as before care; none in week 9.

refund_policy_summary: A $50 deposit per week is non-refundable; it can move to another week until February 28, 2027. Paid balances (minus the deposit) become Y credit only with written notice by April 25, 2027; no refunds if a child leaves early.
notes: 2027 weekly rates: Apple Seeds (ages 2.5 to 3, M/W/F 9 to 11:30) $188; Little Sprouts (ages 4 to 5, 9 to 1) $294; Discovery Camp (entering K, 9 to 4) $375; Explorer Camp (grades 1 to 3) $412; Trailblazer Camp (grades 4 to 5) $412; Adventure Camp (excursion, grades 4 to 6) $438; Crossroads Camp (excursion, grades 7 to 9) $505. Preschool camps run weeks 1 to 8; most others weeks 1 to 9. One rate for everyone; every camper needs a Y membership or the $87 summer camp membership. The $50 per week deposit goes toward tuition. Youngest program starts at age 2.5. Registration opened November 10, 2026.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2027 summer camp page; also the summer camp membership price. age_min rounds the stated 2.5 up to 3; age_max derived from grade 9
